title: Pulmonars
extract:
Pulmonars are  Infested Nunchaku that deal  Viral damage.

Characteristics
This weapon deals  Impact and  Viral damage.
Has a 9-second combo duration.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Atlantis Vulcan and  Mafic Rain (Conclave only) stance.
Innate two  polarities.

Acquisition
The Pulmonars' blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Trivia
Its name is based on the word pulmonar, an adjective that describes anything to do with the lungs.
